title: RC 桥式移相电路
statement: 图示桥式电路中 U̇_s = 10∠0° V（有效值），ω = 1000 rad/s，两个 R_0 = 1 kΩ，可调电阻 R = 1 kΩ，C = 1 µF。输出电压取 U_nm = U_n − U_m。
求 U_n 的有效值、U_nm 的有效值和相位，并分析 R 变化时 U_nm 怎样变化。

questions.ask: R 从 0 调到 ∞ 时，U_nm 怎样变化？
choices: 有效值始终为 5 V，相位从 0° 连续变到 −180°
有效值从 0 增大到 10 V，相位不变
choiceExplain: 这是把 R–C 支路当成纯电阻分压器、又把 U_nm 当成 R 上的电压：那样 R 从 0 调到 ∞ 时它从 0 增到 U_s = 10 V，相位不变。实际上 R、C 上的电压相差 90°，U̇_n 随 R 变化时相位必然改变。
U̇_n = U̇_s/(1 + jωRC) 随 R 变化，而 U̇_m = U̇_s/2 不变，U̇_nm 不可能保持不变：R = 0 时 U̇_nm = 5∠0° V，R = 1 kΩ 时 U̇_nm = −j5 V。
questions.explain: U̇_nm = U̇_s/(1 + jωRC) − U̇_s/2 = (U̇_s/2)·(1 − jωRC)/(1 + jωRC)。分子分母的模相等，所以 |U_nm| = U_s/2 = 5 V 恒定；相位 = −2 arctan(ωRC)，随 R 增大从 0° 变到 −180°。相量图上 U_n 的端点在以 U_m 为圆心、半径 5 V 的半圆上移动。

hints: 左边两个 R_0 相等，U_m = U_s/2，与频率无关。
右边 R、C 串联分压：U̇_n = U̇_s·(1/(jωC))/(R + 1/(jωC)) = U̇_s/(1 + jωRC)。
U_nm = U_n − U_m，把结果写成 (U̇_s/2)·(1 − jωRC)/(1 + jωRC) 的形式，看分子分母的模。
solution: **1. 结点 m。** 两个相等的 R_0 分压：U̇_m = U̇_s/2 = 5∠0° V。
**4. 一般情形。** U̇_nm = U̇_s[1/(1 + jωRC) − 1/2] = (U̇_s/2)·(1 − jωRC)/(1 + jωRC)，|1 − jωRC| = |1 + jωRC|，所以 **|U_nm| = U_s/2 = 5 V 与 R 无关**，相位 φ = −2 arctan(ωRC)。
**5. 相量图。** U_R 与 U_C 互相垂直且和为 U_s，所以 U_n 的端点落在以 U_s 为直径的半圆上；m 是圆心，U_nm 就是半径——长度不变，只转动。调节 R 即可在 0°～−180° 之间移相而幅度不变。

en.title: RC bridge phase shifter
statement: In the bridge circuit U̇_s = 10∠0° V (rms), ω = 1000 rad/s, both R_0 = 1 kΩ, the adjustable resistor R = 1 kΩ and C = 1 µF. The output is U_nm = U_n − U_m.
Find the rms value of U_n, the rms value and phase of U_nm, and describe how U_nm changes when R is varied.

questions.ask: How does U_nm change when R is varied from 0 to ∞?
choices: Its rms value stays 5 V while its phase moves continuously from 0° to −180°
Its rms value rises from 0 to 10 V with the phase unchanged
Neither its rms value nor its phase changes
choiceExplain: This treats the R–C branch as a purely resistive divider and takes U_nm to be the voltage on R: then it would rise from 0 to U_s = 10 V with a fixed phase as R goes from 0 to ∞. In fact the voltages on R and C are 90° apart, so the phase of U̇_n necessarily changes with R.
U̇_n = U̇_s/(1 + jωRC) changes with R while U̇_m = U̇_s/2 does not, so U̇_nm cannot stay fixed: at R = 0, U̇_nm = 5∠0° V; at R = 1 kΩ, U̇_nm = −j5 V.
questions.explain: U̇_nm = U̇_s/(1 + jωRC) − U̇_s/2 = (U̇_s/2)·(1 − jωRC)/(1 + jωRC). Numerator and denominator have equal magnitude, so |U_nm| = U_s/2 = 5 V is constant; the phase is −2 arctan(ωRC), going from 0° to −180° as R increases. In the phasor diagram the tip of U_n moves on a semicircle of radius 5 V centred at U_m.

hints: The two equal R_0 on the left give U_m = U_s/2, independent of frequency.
On the right R and C form a divider: U̇_n = U̇_s·(1/(jωC))/(R + 1/(jωC)) = U̇_s/(1 + jωRC).
U_nm = U_n − U_m; write it as (U̇_s/2)·(1 − jωRC)/(1 + jωRC) and compare the magnitudes of numerator and denominator.
solution: **1. Node m.** The equal R_0 halve the source: U̇_m = U̇_s/2 = 5∠0° V.
**4. In general.** U̇_nm = U̇_s[1/(1 + jωRC) − 1/2] = (U̇_s/2)·(1 − jωRC)/(1 + jωRC); |1 − jωRC| = |1 + jωRC|, so **|U_nm| = U_s/2 = 5 V regardless of R**, with phase φ = −2 arctan(ωRC).

**5. Phasor diagram.** U_R and U_C are perpendicular and add up to U_s, so the tip of U_n lies on the semicircle with U_s as diameter; m is the centre and U_nm is a radius — its length is fixed, it only rotates. Adjusting R shifts the phase between 0° and −180° without changing the amplitude.
